title: ENDEX: Ghost Pumps

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 18:20. The device network remains isolated. Thirteen infusion pumps have not been re-flashed and verified. Central telemetry for ICU 3 North, 3 South, 4 East and 7 East remains off. One-to-one bedside observation continues for 12 high-risk patients. The pump manufacturer has reported the incident to the FDA. The privacy office has initiated a full risk assessment under 45 CFR 164.402. The HCC continues to deliberate on reconnecting the monitoring network. This concludes the exercise.
